The '''sapphire ring''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the possession of [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]. It was recovered from the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in the [[Rahad]] district of [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|4}}

==Appearance==
The ring is average-sized and contains a flawless blue sapphire.

==Use==
When in the presence of someone feeling anger or hostility, the ring will turn cold against the wearer's finger.<ref>{{11|27}}</ref>
